Modeling the Schema in Prisma

Prisma's schema file, and mapping the ticketing domain's relationships onto it.

  • What Is Prisma?

    An ORM for Node — where it resembles Eloquent, and where it deliberately doesn't.

  • Installing Prisma

    Two packages, three new npm scripts, and a config block — the footprint Prisma leaves on package.json.

  • Anatomy of schema.prisma

    Two configuration blocks that sit above every model: which client to generate, and which database to talk to.

  • Fields and Constraints

    The User model: scalar fields, an enum, and the declarative attributes that replace Eloquent's $fillable and validation rules.

  • Two Relations, One Table

  • Two Kinds of Many-to-Many

    TicketTag is a plain link between two tables; TicketWatcher is a link that carries its own data — and that difference has to show up in the schema.
